blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism to explain how language models fit the tail of their training distributions, but its training dynamics are not understood well. In this work, we take a fine-grained look at memorization by decomposing the loss trajectory of memorized sequences over training and model parameters. Across the Pythia family, we study memorization of duplicated training sequences (recitation) and rare ones (recollection). We find that memorization in both cases is characterized by sequence-level gradient alignment, though recitation suffers from misalignment with other training influences which causes forgetting, explaining the necessity for higher duplication of these examples. We further show that the lower model layers are the most involved in memorization and forgetting. Predicting memorization, our decomposition improves over a cross-entropy baseline, especially in larger models and early in training. Intervening on a small set of highly influential parameters we are able to ablate memorization in the final model. Together, these findings advance our understanding of how memorization develops during training and offer insights for predicting and intervening on it.
blocks.zh: 已提议将记忆作为解释语言模型如何适合其培训分发的尾声的一种机制,但其培训动态没有得到很好的理解。 在这部作品中,我们通过将记忆序列的失落轨迹分解于训练和模型参数来细心地看待记忆. 在整个Pythia家族中,我们研究重复的训练序列(引用)和罕见的序列(回忆)的记忆. 我们发现,在这两种情况下,记忆的特点是序列级梯度调整,尽管背诵与其他培训影响不一致,导致遗忘,并解释了这些例子必须更重复。 我们进一步表明,下层模型层是最参与记忆和遗忘的. 我们的分解预示着会比跨度基线有所改进,特别是在更大的模型和早期的训练中。 介入一小组非常有影响力的参数,我们能够在最终模型中放弃记忆. 这些调查结果共同增进了我们对培训期间记忆发展方式的理解,并为预测和干预提供了见解。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models can reproduce training sequences verbatim, a behavior known as memorization ( Feldman, 2020 ) . Despite a growing body of work on this phenomenon, our understanding of how and where memorization develops in the model during training remains limited. This restricts our ability to predict and intervene on memorization, which is desirable for various applications, for instance where privacy or data security are of concern ( Biderman et al., 2026 ) . In this study, we look at memorization as a training dynamic. In particular, we ask which learning contributions along the dimensions of parameters, data, and training process characterize memorization and whether such understanding is actionable for prediction and intervention.
blocks.zh: 语言模型可以复制训练序列的逐字记录,一种被称为记忆的行为(Feldman,2020). 尽管关于这一现象的工作越来越多,但我们对培训期间模式中记忆发展的方式和地点的了解仍然有限。 这限制了我们对记忆的预测和干预能力,这对于各种应用来说是可取的,例如在隐私或数据安全令人关切的情况下(Biderman等人,2026年)。 在这项研究中,我们将记忆视为一种训练动态. 我们尤其询问,在参数、数据和培训过程方面,哪些学习贡献是记忆的特征,这种理解是否可用于预测和干预。

blocks.en: We extend the recently proposed ExPLAIND decomposition ( Eichin et al., 2026 ) , to map a model’s loss trajectory onto its influences along training, parameters, and data. From this decomposition, we derive an intuitive mathematical interpretation of how learning mechanisms like memorization are the result of three aspects: The alignment of a prediction’s gradients to the model parameter update, the magnitude of the training updates, and the sensitivity of a prediction to such updates. We apply ExPLAIND across the pretraining trajectories of the Pythia model family, where we examine recitation (memorization of highly frequent training sequences) and recollection (memorization of rare training sequences). Previous work has shown recitation to be the dominant mode of verbatim memorization ( Prashanth et al., 2025 ) , but it is unclear why their memorization requires duplication, while recollected sequences do not.
blocks.zh: 我们扩展了最近提出的ExPLAIND分解(Eichin等人,2026年),将模型的失落轨迹映射到其训练、参数和数据的影响上。 从这种分解中,我们得出了一个直观的数学解释,即记忆等学习机制是如何由三个方面产生的: 预测的梯度与模型参数更新一致,培训更新的规模,以及预测对此类更新的敏感性. 我们把 ExPLAIND 应用到 Pythia 模型家族的预训轨迹上,我们在这里检查 背诵(高度频繁的训练序列的模拟)和回忆(稀有训练序列的模拟). 之前的作品显示朗诵是逐字记录的主要模式(Prashanth等人,2025年),但不清楚为什么他们的回忆需要重复,而重拾的序列则没有.

blocks.en: We study the training dynamics of memorization in Pythia and show that a large fraction of memorization happens in very early pretraining before basic generalization has manifested. Our decomposition suggests two aspects of memorization: a sequence’s alignment with parameter updates from its own occurrences in training as well as its interaction with the remaining training influences. Memorized sequences exhibit high gradient alignment with their own occurrences, particularly in lower model layers. Highly duplicated, recited sequences tend to exhibit stronger negative alignment with both other training data and weight-decay updates throughout training, suggesting that repeated exposure helps avoid forgetting. On the other hand, recollected sequences with few training occurrences exhibit less negative alignment, consistent with their memorization despite low duplication.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了Pythia记忆的训练动力学,并显示在基本概括表现之前,很大一部分记忆在非常早的预训练中发生. 我们的解析表明,记忆有两个方面:一个序列与参数的更新保持一致,这是它本身在培训中出现的情况,以及它与其余培训影响的相互作用。 记忆序列显示高度梯度与自身的发生一致,特别是在较低的模型层. 高度重复的、背诵的序列往往与其他培训数据和在整个培训过程中的减重更新都表现出更强烈的负面一致性,这表明反复接触有助于避免忘记。 另一方面,尽管重复程度较低,但经过重新收集的训练次数较少的序列显示出较少的负面调整。

blocks.en: To validate our understanding, we test these explanations through early prediction and post-hoc intervention. Features derived from the decomposition improve memorization prediction over a cross-entropy baseline, particularly in larger models and early in training. Interventions on a small set of parameters identified as influential early in pretraining, mostly in lower attention and MLP layers, ablate memorization in the final model.
blocks.zh: 为了证实我们的理解,我们通过早期预测和事后干预测试这些解释。 分解所衍生的特征改进了对跨线基线的记忆预测,特别是在更大的模型和早期训练中. 在早期预训中被确定为有影响力的一小组参数上进行干预,多见于低关注层和MLP层,在最终模型中淡化记忆.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism for deep learning models to fit long-tail distributions ( Arpit et al., 2017 ; Chatterjee, 2018 ; Feldman, 2020 ) , and has been validated and studied in various works ( Feldman & Zhang, 2020 ; Zheng & Jiang, 2022 ) . Memorization in Pythia has been studied by Biderman et al. (2023a) , who find that memorization is predictable during pretraining and scales with model size. Further, Prashanth et al. (2025) study Pythia’s memorization through the lens of training corpus statistics and further argue for a taxonomy for memorization based on duplication, which has been shown to be one factor of memorization Lee et al. (2022) . We follow their approach and investigate memorization with high (recitation) and low duplication (recollection) but we predict memorization in much earlier training phases and with features derived from our loss decomposition. Tirumala et al. (2022) also study the training dynamics of memorization and find larger models to memorize faster, which our results contradict, and forget less, which we also find and explain.
blocks.zh: 纪念被提出作为深度学习模型适应长尾分布的机制(Arpit等人,2017年;Chatterjee,2018年;Feldman,2020年),并在各种作品中被验证和研究(Feldman & Zhang,2020年;Zheng & Jiang,2022年). Biderman等人(2023年a)研究了Pythia中的记忆,他们发现在预训期间和具有模型大小的尺度上,记忆是可预测的. 此外,Prashanth等人(2025年)通过培训教程统计的透镜研究Pythia的记忆,并进一步论证基于重复的记忆分类法,这已被证明是记忆李等人(2022年)的一个因素. 我们遵循他们的方法,用高(引用)和低重复(回忆)来调查记忆问题,但我们预测在更早的训练阶段就进行记忆,并用我们的损失分解得出的特征来调查. Tirumala等人(2022年)也研究了记忆化的训练动力学,并找到更大型的模型来更快地记忆,我们的结果与之相矛盾,而忘记的也更少,我们也找到和解释了这些模型.

blocks.en: We also localize memorization, i.e., find the model parameters or layers implementing recall of memories, which has been another popular focus ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Maini et al., 2023 ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Ortu et al., 2024 ) , though the faithfulness of existing methods has been questioned ( Chang et al., 2024 ) . Previous work has argued that both MLP layers ( Geva et al., 2021 ; Dai et al., 2022 ) and attention heads ( Stoehr et al., 2024 ) are involved in the mechanisms for recall, which our results confirm. Further, Mireshghallah et al. (2022) identifies the model embeddings as an important factor for recall. Memorization has also been contrasted with generalization by various works ( Zheng & Jiang, 2022 ; Dankers & Titov, 2024 ) , which show that memorization and generalization are entangled ( Du et al., 2025 ; Dankers, 2026 ) . Our results also indicate an interdependence of generalization and memorization, with both emerging roughly at the same time in early pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们还将记忆化本地化,即找到执行记忆召回的模型参数或层层,这是另一个热门焦点(Meng等人,2022年;Maini等人,2023年;Jia等人,2025年;Ortu等人,2024年),尽管现有方法的忠实性受到质疑(Chang等人,2024年). 先前的工作认为,MLP层(Geva等人,2021年;Dai等人,2022年)和注意力头(Stoehr等人,2024年)都参与了召回机制,我们的结果证实了这一点。 此外,Mireshghallah等人(2022年)认为嵌入模型是召回的一个重要因素。 回忆与各种作品的概括化也形成对比(郑和江,2022;丹克尔斯与蒂托夫,2024),显示回忆和概括的纠缠(杜等人,2025;丹克尔斯,2026). 我们的结果表明,一般化和记忆化是相互依存的,两者在早期的预训中大致同时出现。

blocks.en: As regards methodology, gradient-based data attribution relates training examples to the evaluation loss ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ; Pruthi et al., 2020 ) , while loss change allocation maps it across parameters and training ( Lan et al., 2019 ; Kangaslahti et al., 2025 ) . Our study is based on Eichin et al. (2026) ’s decomposition, which builds on work by Bell et al. (2023) , and is the only unified and exact approach combining both. We extend it to an explicit notion of alignment between train influences and the prediction. Further, we validate our findings using prediction and causal intervention over training.
blocks.zh: 关于方法,基于梯度的数据归属将培训实例与评价损失联系起来(Koh & Liang, 2017;Pruthi等人, 2020年),而损失变化分布图则贯穿参数和培训(Lan等人, 2019;Kangaslahti等人, 2025年)。 我们的研究以艾钦等人(2026年)的分解为基础,以贝尔等人(2023年)的工作为基础,是将两者结合起来的唯一统一而精确的方法. 我们把它扩大到一个明确的概念,即火车影响与预测之间保持一致。 此外,我们利用预测和对培训的因果干预来验证我们的调查结果。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our study is based on the ExPLAIND decomposition of gradient descent models by Eichin et al. (2026) . Using their central Theorem, we decompose a model’s loss into per-sample and per-parameter contributions across training. We extend it by further decomposing their influence scores into parts that can be interpreted as the sensitivity of the prediction, the magnitude of the parameter update, and the alignment of a parameter update with the prediction’s gradient. We apply their Theorem 3.1 and Corollary 3.3 to the evaluation loss and state the accumulated result below (full proof in App. A ).

blocks.en:
Experiment settings. To study the training dynamics of verbatim memorization in LLMs, we use our decomposition to analyze LLMs across the Pythia family ( Biderman et al., 2023b ) , which provide fine-grained access to checkpoints and training data and for which an exhaustive searches of duplicated and memorized sequences exists.
We focus on Pythia- 1 1 B as our object of study, though we perform all experiments for models of size 160 160 m, 410 410 m, 1 1 B, 1.4 1.4 B, 2.8 2.8 B, and 6.9 6.9 B, unless stated otherwise. For all numeric results and figures we present, we link to a version in the Appendix containing the same data for the other models.
We study memorized sequences over training and decompose their cross entropy (CE) loss, which we sample from an exhaustive dataset of memorized sequences by Biderman et al. (2023a) for each model. We use their definition of memorization as 32 32 -extractability, i.e., whether, given the first 32 32 tokens of the sequence, the model greedily generates the next 32 32 tokens verbatim. We filter out sequences with repeating subsequences (”reconstruction” in Prashanth et al. (2025) ’s taxonomy) and samples of code, which we found to often contain boilerplate sequences, resulting in memorized examples resembling natural language. We follow Prashanth et al. (2025) ’s taxonomy and further discriminate between recollected (memorized sequences that appear up to five times in the training set) and recited sequences (memorized sequences that appear more than five times in the training set). To contextualize our results, we include two control groups, control and control-duplicated , whose samples also occur up to and more than five times, respectively, but are not 32-extractable in the final model. For each of the four classes, we sample 32 sequences and study their decomposition. Details on datasets and implementations in App. B .

实验设置. 为了研究LLMs的逐字记录培训动态,我们利用我们的分解分析Pythia家族的LLMs(Biderman等人,2023年b),它们提供了精细的进入检查站和培训数据的机会,为此存在对重复和记忆序列的详尽搜索。
我们把Pythia-1 1 B作为我们的研究对象,虽然我们对所有大小为160 160米,410 410米,1 1 B,1.4 1.4 B,2.8 2.8 B和6.9 6.9 B的模型进行实验,除非另有说明. 对于我们提出的所有数字结果和数字,我们链接到附录中载有其他模型相同数据的版本。

blocks.en: To our surprise, we could not verify 32 32 -extractability for around 10 − 20 % 10-20\% sequences sampled from Biderman et al. (2023a) ’s dataset across model sizes. To investigate this discrepancy, we plot the average fraction of the correct continuation token being the maximum logit prediction across all sequences in Fig. 1(d) . The problem only shows for a small fraction of tokens, which indicates the problem is likely due to small numeric differences of our hardware and implementation for obtaining the logits. While we do not consider this a problem for our analysis, it calls into question whether demanding strict 32-extractable yields a robust definition of verbatim memorization.
blocks.zh: 出乎我们意料的是,我们无法验证从Biderman等人(2023a)在模型大小上的数据集中取样的大约10 - 20% 10 - 20 - 20%的序列的32 32 - 可提取性。 为了调查这一差异,我们绘制正确续作符号的平均比例是图1(d)中所有序列的最大对数预测。 问题只显示一小部分的令牌,这说明问题很可能是由于我们硬件和执行中小的数字差异来获取对数. 虽然我们不认为这是我们分析的问题,但它使人怀疑,要求严格的32-可摘录是否会产生对逐字记录的有力定义。

blocks.en: Scaling to LLMs. We adapt our decomposition to Pythia and to its large training data as follows. First, following Eichin et al. (2026) , we do not require access to the full training trajectory: we subsample the training steps to the set S S of available checkpoints and decompose a simulated update per checkpoint θ s \theta_{s} . Since the Pythia models do not provide optimizer states, we omit the first-moment term u s fm u_{s}^{\mathrm{fm}} and estimate the second-moment from independent samples of training data (details in App. A.2 ). We consider our second moment estimate effective at realistically rescaling the parameter updates, since our simulated parameter updates consistently decrease loss on the memorized and control groups. Second, we sample a training batch from the tail of Pythia’s training data, i.e. unseen by any of the checkpoints but the last one, with an original batch size of 2 ​ M 2M tokens. Using this approach, we also inject our sampled sequences into the batch to simulate their occurrence during training (as proposed by Körner et al. 2026 ). This way, we can compute the influence a memorized instance would have over training without searching for and decomposing the actual occurrences. We compute the simulated parameter update over the resulting batch to obtain θ s + 1 \theta_{s+1} .

blocks.en: To get a high-level understanding of how memorization behavior in Pythia develops over time, we plot the loss and 32-extractability of the sequences we study in Fig. 1 . Surprisingly, the loss trajectory of both the recited and recollected sequences separates from the control groups as early as 256 256 and 1,000 1,000 steps respectively, i.e., less than 1 % 1\% of the training. While previous work shows that memorization in Pythia is predictable from the perplexity in the final checkpoint ( Prashanth et al., 2025 ) , this result suggests that a separation of memorized and not memorized sequences is possible at much earlier training stages than reported by Biderman et al. (2023a) , with the peak mean distance of the two classes reached as early as the halfway point of training and stable trajectories throughout. Adding to this, almost half of our memorized samples are already 32-extractable at this point as can be seen from Fig. 1(c) , i.e., memorization has already concluded for these instances. We show that this indeed leads to much earlier predictability of memorization in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 为了获得对Pythia中记忆行为如何随时间发展的高级别理解,我们绘制了我们在Fig中研究的序列的损失和32的可提取性. 1 (英语). 令人惊讶的是,背诵的和重拾的序列的丢失轨迹早在256个256个步和1000个1000个步就分别从控制组中分离出来,即不到训练的1%的1\%. 虽然以前的工作显示,Pythia的记忆可以从最终检查站的迷惑性中预测(Prashanth等人,2025年),但这一结果表明,在比德曼等人(2023年a)报告的更早的训练阶段,记忆和不记忆序列的分离是可能的,两个班的峰值平均距离早在培训的中点就已经达到,整个轨道也稳定。 此外,从图1(c)中可以看出,我们记忆中的几乎一半样本目前已经可以提取32份,即关于这些情况的纪念已经完成。 我们显示,这确实导致第4.2节中更早的记忆可预见性。

blocks.en: A large fraction of memorized tokens is extractable early in training. Further, the token-extractability trajectory reveals that a large fraction of the memorization learning happens in early training (see Fig. 1(d) ). By 10 10 k steps, the model already greedily decodes more than 80% of the memorized sequences, almost double the number of the control groups. This shows that strict 32-extractability as a measure lags behind the continuous, token-level emergence of verbatim memorization, of which a large fraction happens in early training before step 20 20 k.
blocks.zh: 很大一部分的纪念物在训练初期是可以提取的。 此外,象征性的可提取性轨迹表明,记忆学习的很大一部分发生在早期训练中(见图1(d))。 通过10个10千步,模型已经贪婪地解码了超过80%的记忆序列,几乎是控制组数的两倍. 这表明,严格的32-可提取性作为衡量标准落后于连续的,象征性的逐字记录式的出现,其中很大一部分发生在20k步骤前的早期训练中.

blocks.en: Memorization during generalization? We also track basic linguistic competence of the model through the widely used BLiMP benchmark ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) (see App. Fig. 10 ), which measures the model’s ability to differentiate between linguistic minimal pairs. Interestingly, this evaluation of basic generalization in the model reaches its first plateau around 10 10 k. Given that much of memorization develops before this mark and that our samples are mostly composed of natural English language, this suggests that memorization in Pythia happens not after but during or even before generalization in form of basic linguistic capability.
blocks.zh: 概括时的纪念? 我们还通过广泛使用的BLIMP基准跟踪模型的基本语言能力(Warstadt等人,2020年)(见App.Fig.10),该基准衡量模型区分语言最小对的能力。 有趣的是,这种对模型中基本概括性的评价达到了10千米左右的第一个高原. 鉴于在这个标记之前已经发展出许多记忆,而且我们的样本大多由自然英语组成,这表明在Pythia的记忆不是在之后,而是在以基本语言能力的形式进行概括之前发生的。

blocks.en: To understand how the above dynamics emerge, we turn to the ExPLAIND decomposition. Interestingly, on the level of update magnitude ∥ u s x ∥ \lVert u_{s}^{x}\rVert and test sensitivity ∥ Φ s ​ ( x ) ∥ \lVert\Phi_{s}(x)\rVert , the four classes undergo similar trends (see Fig. 2(a) , 2(b) ). Recited instances, on average, show the lowest update magnitude, while exhibiting the highest test sensitivity. In contrast recollected instances have lower test sensitivity late in training and cluster with the control groups in terms of early sensitivity and update magnitude.
blocks.zh: 为了了解上述动态是如何出现的,我们转向ExPLAIND分解. 有趣的是,在更新的星等上 u s x \ l ert u _{s}^{x}\r Vert和测试灵敏度 QQ s (x) \lVert\Phi_{s}(x)\rVert,这四门课都经历了类似的趋势(见图2(a),2(b)). 反复出现的情况平均显示更新幅度最低,同时显示测试敏感性最高。 与此相对照的是,在培训较晚阶段,在早期敏感性和更新规模方面,重新收集的试验敏感度较低,与控制组分组。

blocks.en: Memorization is enabled by self alignment. Self alignment cos ⁡ ( Φ s ​ ( x ) , u s x ) \cos(\Phi_{s}(x),u_{s}^{x}) is where we find one of the reasons for the diverging loss trajectories. First, consider Fig. 2(c) , where we plot the alignment of each predicted example with its own training influence. From the beginning of training and with further separation after step 512, the memorized samples show much higher levels of self alignment than the control groups. Recited instances, at 0.3 0.3 to 0.4 0.4 on average, show the highest level of self alignment for the rest of training, followed by the recollected instances around 0.25 0.25 . Self alignment in the two control groups follows the same trajectory and is the lowest at around 0.18 0.18 through most of later training. This indicates that the tendency to move prediction towards a memorized solution is on average more than twice as high for recited instances than it is for non-memorized instances, while this gap is smaller for recollected instances.
blocks.zh: 记忆通过自我对齐实现. 自我对齐 cos = (Φ s (x), u s x )\cos (\Phi_{ s} (x), u_{s}^{x}) 是我们发现不同损失轨迹的原因之一. 首先,考虑图2(c),我们在图2(c)中将每个预测的例子与其本身的培训影响结合起来。 从培训开始,在步骤512后进一步分离,被记住的样本显示出比控制组高得多的自适应水平. 复发事件平均为0.3至0.4,显示其余培训的自适应程度最高,随后是复发事件,约为0.250.25。 两个控制组的自我对齐遵循相同的轨迹,通过以后的大部分训练,在0.180.18左右是最低的. 这表明,将预测推向有记忆的解决方案的趋势,对于被背诵的事例来说,平均比对非被背诵的事例要高一倍多,而对于被背诵的事例来说,这一差距较小。

blocks.en: Training causes more forgetting in recited than recollected samples. Memorization is however not just driven by the sample predictions’ tendency to align with their own effect on parameter updates, but by how likely the achieved solution is to survive the other training influences pulling towards generalization. We study the effect of the other training instances on memorized predictions in Fig. 2(d) . While positively aligned with the training data’s updates until step 128, the green recited instances start to show distinctively negative, lower alignment starting from step 256 which keeps decreasing until the end of training. On the other hand, the recollected and control group samples cluster around zero for most of training. This negative alignment suggests that the memorized solution to the recited instances is constantly overwritten by the parameter updates introduced by the other data, while recollected and control examples are, on average, not subject to such influences after initial training. This suggests one core mechanism behind recollection: While recited instances need to be duplicated to reinforce their respective memorized solution against being overwritten by the other training influences, recollected instances, i.e., memorized examples that are not duplicated across training, exist in a part of the parameter space that is, on average, orthogonal to such influences and they do not require continued repair.
blocks.zh: 培训比重新收集的样品更让人忘却。 然而,记忆的驱动力不仅仅是因为样本预测在参数更新方面与自身效果一致的倾向,而是因为所实现的解决方案在其它训练影响下能否幸存下去。 我们研究其他培训对图2(d)中已记住的预测的影响。 虽然积极配合培训数据更新到第128步,但绿色朗诵的例子开始明显显示负面的、较低的校正,从第256步开始,直到培训结束为止。 另一方面,对大多数培训来说,回收和控制组样本集中在零左右。 这种负面的对齐表明,背诵实例的记忆解决方案经常被其他数据引入的参数更新所覆盖,而重拾和控制实例一般在初始培训后不受这种影响。 这表明记忆背后有一个核心机制: 虽然需要重复引用实例,以加强各自记忆中的解决办法,避免被其他培训影响所覆盖,但被回忆的实例,即没有在整个培训中重复的记忆实例,存在于参数空间中,平均而言,这些参数空间是正向的,不需要继续修复。

blocks.en: 4.2 Memorization prediction
blocks.zh: 4.2 记忆预测

blocks.en: To validate our explanations of memorization above, we ask to what extent the memorized examples are really separated by the phenomena we describe above. We investigate this through a binary linear least squares classifier using our decomposition as features. We standardize the features and use ridge coefficient 10 − 8 10^{-8} in a stratified six-fold cross-validation across our 128 128 examples, to avoid reliance on hyperparameter tuning. We report average accuracy on the held out fold as well as the average weight assigned to each feature. For an example x x and a model checkpoint θ s \theta_{s} at step s s , we consider features including cross-entropy CE ⁡ ( θ s , x ) \mathrm{CE}(\theta_{s},x) , a strong predictor for memorization identified by previous work ( Prashanth et al., 2025 ) , and our decomposition features over time. Namely, we consider self alignment , train alignment , and weight decay alignment , i.e., the cosine cos ⁡ ( Φ s ​ ( x ) , u s ) \cos(\Phi_{s}(x),u_{s}) with the update u s u_{s} introduced by the example itself, the original training data, and weight decay respectively as defined in Eq. 2 and 5 . We also consider test sensitivity ∥ Φ s ​ ( x ) ∥ \lVert\Phi_{s}(x)\rVert and update magnitude ∥ u s ∥ \lVert u_{s}\rVert , totaling five decomposition features. Since both classes are stratified along duplication in the training data, we do not consider it as a feature. For each step, we use the features derived from only that step’s checkpoint. This way, our insights could benefit realistic settings, where predictions need to be made without access to the model’s history or future.

blocks.en: Memorization is predictable early in training. We find that very early on in training, all linear models perform above chance. As shown in Fig. 3(a) , up until step 256 all feature combinations perform roughly similarly at around 67 67 to 69 % 69\% accuracy. After that, their performance trajectories split with the CE+decomposition feature scoring the highest at 90.6 % 90.6\% accuracy at step 10 ​ k 10k , while cross-entropy only and decomposition only follow at 84.4 % 84.4\% and 75.0 % 75.0\% respectively. The combined model keeps outperforming for the remaining checkpoints, peaking at 96.1 % 96.1\% accuracy by step 40 40 k. This confirms our observations above: By that point more than half of memorization learning is already completed, i.e., many examples are already 32-extractable and the mean cross-entropies have separated by almost two standard deviations (see Fig. 1 ). Besides, this prediction at scale has been reported at such later training stages by Biderman et al. (2023a) .
blocks.zh: 在早期培训中,记忆是可以预测的。 我们发现,很早就在训练中, 所有线性模型都表现优于偶然。 如图3(a)所示,在步骤256之前,所有特性组合的性能大致相同,精确度约为67-69%-69%。 之后,他们的性能轨迹与CE+分解特征分解,最高的分数在10k 10k 的精度为90.6% 90.6QQ,而交叉交替和分解分别跟随84.4% 84.4% 84.4Q和75.0% 75.0QX. 综合模式使其余检查站的业绩优于其他检查站,在40k步中达到96.1%的准确度。 这证实了我们上文的意见: 至此,超过一半的记忆学习已经完成,即许多例子已经是32个可以提取的,而平均跨线的间隔则几乎有两个标准偏差(见图1). 此外,Biderman等人(2023a)在后来的训练阶段报告了这种规模的预测。

blocks.en: Besides cross-entropy, self and train alignment are the strongest predictors of memorization. To investigate which features are the most predictive of memorization, we plot the feature weights in Fig. 3(b) . Underlining our assessment above, self alignment is the highest positive predictor over almost all checkpoints, while alignment with the original training influences is the most negative. We also look at the decomposition feature weights of the combined model in Fig. 3(c) . Interestingly, update magnitude and self alignment do not seem to add information beyond cross entropy as their weight is low over most models. Train and weight decay alignment also show negative predictive influence, while especially test sensitivity seems like the most informative component in early training, indicating that alignment with and sensitivity to forgetting are the factors not explained by CE alone.
blocks.zh: 除了跨纵横外,自我和列车对齐也是最强的记忆预测器. 为了调查哪些特征最能预测记忆,我们在图3(b)中绘制了特征权重。 上文强调我们的评估,自我调整是几乎所有检查站的最高积极预测,而与最初的培训影响保持一致是最消极的。 我们还研究了图3(c)中综合模型的分解特征权重。 有趣的是,更新的尺寸和自我对齐似乎不会增加超过交叉 en的信息,因为它们的重量比大多数模型都低. 列车和重量衰减调整也显示出负面的预测性影响,而特别的测试敏感性似乎是早期训练中信息最丰富的部分,表明与遗忘保持一致和对遗忘的敏感性是CE本身无法解释的因素.

blocks.en: For larger models, cross-entropy is less predictive of memorization. We perform the same naive classification across model scales (see App. Fig. 19 ) and find that cross entropy is a weaker early predictor of memorization as model size increases. Considering that the average cross entropies of the control sequences decreases as model size increases (see App. Fig. 9 ), this is consistent with our expectations. Interestingly, adding our decomposition features recovers a lot of the early predictability. For Pythia- 6.9 6.9 B, the CE+decomposition model still achieves 88.3 % 88.3\% accuracy at step 10 10 k, while the CE only model is at 77.3 % 77.3\% . There, the CE model never catches up with the combined feature model, reaching comparable accuracy only in the final checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 对于较大的模型来说,交叉内质对记忆的预测性较低. 我们在模型尺度上进行同样的天真分类(见App. Fig. 19),发现随着模型大小的增大,交叉 en是记忆的较弱早期预测器. 考虑到控制序列的平均横跨体数随着模型尺寸的增加而减少(见App. Fig. 9),这符合我们的预期. 有趣的是,加上我们的分解特征,可以恢复很多早期的可预测性. 对于Pythia- 6.9 6.9 B,CE+分解模型仍然在10 10 k步中达到88.3%的88.3\%精度,而CE唯一的模型为77.3%的77.3\%. 在那里,CE模型从未赶上合并特征模型,仅在最终检查站达到可比的准确度.

blocks.en: We decompose our influences to the level of the model layers to see where the above learning influences stem from and to find the parameters implementing memorization. Our decomposition reveals that memorization influences are spread across the model, while peaking distinctly in some regions which we describe in the following. Our findings agree with arguments by which verbatim memorization is a distributed mechanism across the model ( Maini et al., 2023 ; Dankers, 2026 ) , and add further explanation to the conflicting findings in previous work regarding localization, beyond variation in memorization settings and methodology.
blocks.zh: 我们将影响分解到模型层的水平,以了解上述学习影响来自何处,并找出执行记忆的参数。 我们的分解表明,记忆影响遍布整个模型,而在某些区域则明显达到顶峰,我们在下文对此作了说明。 我们的调查结果同意这样的论点,即逐字记录是整个模型的分布机制(Maini等人,2023年;Dankers,2026年),并进一步解释了以往关于本地化的工作中相互矛盾的调查结果,超出了记忆设置和方法的变化。

blocks.en:
Memorization learning is largely located in lower layers. As we show in Fig. 4 , our decomposition reveals that the memorized instances are most sensitive to model changes in the lower layers of the model throughout all of training. Simultaneously, self alignment as shown in Fig. 5 is the highest in the same layers, showing that a large fraction of memorization learning is located there.
On the level of the update magnitude, Fig. 4 shows that training introduces the biggest changes to the input embeddings, while the other layer groups follow behind at similar levels.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Memorization learning focuses on the MLP layers. Turning to Fig. 5 , where we plot self alignment grouped by layer type, we find that both forms of memorization self align the most in the MLP layers beginning early in training, while for both control groups it is roughly half of that throughout training. As we saw before, input embedding alignment is the most relevant source of alignment for both control groups and on par with MLP alignment in the recollected examples. Alignment in the attention QKV projections is also much higher in the memorized examples than the control groups.

blocks.en: Recited memories degrade in lower layers. In Fig. 6 , we plot the alignment across layer regions with the original training data’s parameter updates. We find that the effects from the training data onto the recited instances align in the lower model layers 0 0 - 3 3 , much more than for recollected examples and especially during late training. We find the same for alignment with weight decay, which we plot in Fig. 6 . There, alignment of recited instances is high throughout training, while alignment of recollected examples tends to zero in the second half of training. Combined with the fact that test sensitivity is the highest in these layers, this explains why recited instances depend on a high level of duplication during training: As training progresses, their memories written to the parameters of the lower model layers are subject to constant forgetting due to the influences of other data and regularization, thus requiring the continued restoration of these memories. On the other hand, recollected sequences are subject to such degrading influences to a much smaller extent. The mechanisms for recall that their gradients write onto lower model layers are more robust against other training influences and thus require only a low level of verbatim duplication to remain effective.

blocks.en: Ablation in the embeddings is not effective. Recall that a large fraction of memorization updates stems from the input embeddings. Consequently, we find that directly using the influence scores to rank parameters is biased heavily towards them (see App. Fig. 21 ). As we scale up the fraction of ablated parameters, model behavior in terms of CE on the control groups breaks down in sync with memorization. This indicates that the memorization influences in the embeddings, especially update magnitude, are an artifact of training rather than a causal building block of memorization. We thus restrict our following interventions to internal parameters.
blocks.zh: 嵌入物中的缩放无效. 回顾记忆更新的很大一部分来源于输入嵌入. 因此,我们发现,直接利用影响分数对参数进行排名,对它们有严重的偏差(见App.Fig. 21)。 随着我们放大了减速参数的分量, 模型行为在控制组上的CE 与记忆同步。 这表明嵌入物中的记忆影响,特别是更新的体积,是训练的产物,而不是记忆的因果基石. 因此,我们将以下发言限于内部参数。

blocks.en: Our influences enable sparse and early memorization ablations. We plot 32-extractability of our sampled sequences across different fractions of ablated parameters K K and using the accumulated influence scores from different points in training in Fig. 7 . Strikingly, as early as step 2000 2000 , the information from our decomposition robustly ablates memorization behavior across our samples, with 32-extractability approaching zero when ablating the top-0.0002 parameters of Pythia- 1 1 B. Later in training, these interventions become focused, as complete ablation succeeds up to a sparsity of top- 0.00002 0.00002 intervened. At the same time, we observe cross entropy on the control samples to check whether our interventions simply break general model behavior and indeed, only the largest ablations break model behavior, while changes in the smaller interventions are modest below 0.1 0.1 . We plot the results of the other models up to 2.8 2.8 B parameters in App. Fig. 20 which show that our findings generalize across models, i.e., for each model size there is a number of parameters which both effectively ablates memorization and leaves control cross-entropy intact. We consider this a very interesting result, since both our localization, as well as the intervention on parameters, are quite naively building on our decomposition. It causally underlines that our decomposition identifies the locations of the memories in the model successfully and that actionable post-hoc fixes are possible.
blocks.zh: 我们的影响力使得人们能够轻而易举地及早回忆。 我们绘制了32集的样本序列的可提取性, 跨越不同分量的宽减参数KK, 并使用不同点的累积影响分数 在Fig训练中。 7. 令人惊奇的是,早在2000年阶段,我们从分解中得出的信息就强烈地抑制了我们样本中的记忆行为,在粉碎Pythia-1 1 B的0.0002参数时,32的可提取性接近零。 在培训后,这些干预变得重点突出,因为彻底的分解成功,达到0.00002 0.00002的断层。 同时,我们观测到控制样本上的交叉 en,以检查我们的干预是否只是打破了一般模型行为,事实上,只是最大的崩坏模型行为,而较小的干预的变化则微乎其微,低于0.10.1. 我们在App. Fig. 20中绘制了其他模型的 2.8 B 参数的结果, 显示我们的调查结果概括了模型, 即每个模型大小都有一些参数, 既能有效地减少记忆, 也能使控制跨体性保持完整。 我们认为这是一个非常有趣的结果,因为我们的本地化,以及对参数的干预,都非常天真地建立在我们的分解之上。 它因果地强调,我们的分解成功确定了模型中记忆的位置,并且可以操作的后热修复.

blocks.en: Memorization in smaller models is ablated by a single attention head. Interestingly, most of the ablated parameters are located in the attention layers (see App. Fig. 22 ) and we find that recited instances tend to align with other recited instances in the lower attention layers (see App. C.4 ). Motivated by this, we intervene on the attention heads in these layers. Interestingly, we find that, up to 1 1 B parameters, memorization can be ablated by intervening on a single attention head using our naive approach, a result which echoes Stoehr et al. (2024) who find similar results for fine-tuning an attention head in a small GPT-Neo model. Details in App. Sec. C.4 .
blocks.zh: 在较小的模型中,记忆被单个的注意力头所淡化. 有趣的是,大部分被放弃的参数都位于关注层(见App. Fig. 22),我们发现被背诵的实例往往与低关注层中其他被背诵的实例一致(见App. C.4. 以此为动机,我们介入了这些层层的注意力。 有趣的是,我们发现,多达11 B 个参数,通过使用我们天真的方法干预一个单一的注意力头可以减缓记忆,这个结果与Stoehr等人(2024年)相呼应,后者发现在小型GPT-Neo模型中微调注意力头的类似结果. 详情见App. Sec. C. 4.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion & Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Our work presents novel perspectives on the training dynamics of memorization in LLMs. Here we review our results along the time and model scale dimensions.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作提出了关于法学硕士课程记忆培训动态的新观点。 在此,我们按照时间和模型尺度来审查我们的成果。

blocks.en: Memorization follows three training phases. Across models, the loss of both the memorized and control instances flattens around the 5 5 k step mark. This co-occurs with the saturation of the model’s performance in BLiMP, which marks an important phase transition in language model generalization ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Most memorization follows a similar trajectory, with more than 80 % 80\% of the tokens already greedily decodeable at the same point. Decomposing their loss trajectory reveals that on the model- and layer-level almost all the trends of the influences start to stabilize around that point. This development seems to be completed around the 20 20 k mark. Further, our layer-level results indicate that in the first 10 10 k steps, the training dynamics introduce a shared mechanism for memorization in an attention head in the first transformer layer. This aligns with other reports of early heuristics for context processing, for instance context copying ( Körner et al., 2026 ) . Further, memorization predictability starts to become successful around step 10 ​ k 10k and reaches its peak shortly after for most models. In sum, this suggests that most of the memorization mechanisms are formed in early training and that later memorization dynamics are largely refining and maintaining existing memories, rather than building new ones. Further, it suggests that memorization and generalization appear in parallel in the model. We argue the point of emergence of both, around step 5 5 k, to be the first phase transition of memorization. The second transition seems to happen somewhere around step 20 20 k, when most of our influences stabilize and after which predictability converges.
blocks.zh: 备忘录分三个培训阶段。 在模型上, 记忆和控制的大小 都会在 5 5 k 的步号上平缓。 这与模型在BLIMP中性能的饱和化共同标志着语言模型泛化的重要阶段过渡(Chen等人,2024年). 大部分的纪念品都遵循类似的轨迹,80%以上的纪念品在同一点已经可以贪婪地解码. 分解其损失轨迹表明,在模型和层层上,影响的所有趋势几乎都开始在该点周围稳定下来。 这一开发似乎在20千米左右完成. 此外,我们分层的结果表明,在前10个10千步中,训练动力学在第一个变压器层的注意力头中引入了共同的记忆机制. 这与其他早期的上下文处理方法(例如上下文复制)的报告一致(Körner等人,2026年)。 此外,对大多数模型来说,在10k 10k步骤周围的记忆可预测性开始取得成功,并在不久之后达到顶峰。 总而言之,这表明大多数的记忆机制都是在早期训练中形成的,后来的记忆动力学基本上是在提炼和保持现有的记忆,而不是建立新的记忆. 此外,它建议在模型中同时出现纪念和概括. 我们主张,这两个步骤的出现点,围绕步骤5 5 k,是纪念的第一阶段过渡。 第二次过渡似乎在20k步骤的某个地方发生,那时我们的大多数影响都稳定下来,然后可以预测。

blocks.en: Memorization and model scale. Previous work asks how memorization behaves as a function of model scale ( Tirumala et al., 2022 ) . As we report in Sec. 4 , as model scale increases, the training data is fit to a higher extent, resulting in the average CE loss approaching that of the memorized instances. Predicting memorization based on solely CE or perplexity is more difficult in these models, though we show features derived from our gradient decomposition to recover some of the early predictability observed in the smaller models. Further, as model scale increases, our decomposition shows that the constant forgetting effects in the lower parts of the model due to training and weight decay become weaker, thus explaining the findings by Tirumala et al. (2022) . For the largest models, weight decay even is slightly aligned with memorization on average. This could explain previous observations by which memorization scales with model size ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Biderman et al., 2023a ) .
blocks.zh: 纪念和模型尺度。 先前的作品询问了记忆作为模型尺度的一种功能是如何表现的(Tirumala等人,2022年). 正如我们在第4节中报告的那样,随着模型规模的扩大,培训数据更适合使用,导致平均CE损失接近被记住的例子。 在这些模型中,仅仅基于CE或复杂度的预测性记忆更难,尽管我们显示了从梯度分解中得出的特征,以恢复较小模型中观察到的一些早期可预测性。 此外,随着模型尺度的增大,我们的分解表明,由于训练和重量衰减,模型下部不断被遗忘的影响变得较弱,从而解释了Tirumala等人(2022年)的调查结果。 对于最大的模型来说,重量衰减甚至与平均的记忆略为一致. 这可以解释以前对模型大小的纪念尺度的观察(Carlini等人,2023年;Biderman等人,2023年a年)。

blocks.en:
Limitations. Our methodology omits the influences of the first moment term in AdamW and estimates the second moment. Both choices could bias our results. Besides, our memorization prediction should be seen as a validation of our explanations and a proof-of-concept rather than a direct competitor to Biderman et al. (2023a) and Prashanth et al. (2025) ’s approaches over the entire training dataset. Computing our ExPLAIND features over the entire dataset is infeasible, though we think that gradient based proxies derived from parameter updates of the train loop are a promising possibility. Our interventions likewise validate the analysis but are post-hoc in nature: they do not establish how to prevent memorization during training, and their effects on robustness and other predictions remain unclear.
Finally, our findings concern verbatim memorization in the Pythia family up to 6.9 6.9 B parameters. Their generalizability to larger models, other architectures, and other forms of memorization, for instance in the vision domain or in a noisy label setting, remains open.
blocks.zh:
限制。 我们的方法忽略了亚当W的第一个瞬间词的影响,并估计了第二个瞬间. 这两种选择都可能对我们的结果产生偏见。 此外,我们的记忆预测应该被看作是对我们的解释的验证和概念的证明,而不是比德曼等人(2023年a)和普拉尚特等人(2025年)对整个培训数据集的做法的直接竞争者。 在整个数据集中计算我们的 ExPLAIND 特性是不可行的,尽管我们认为,基于梯度的代词 来源于参数更新 列车环路是一个很有希望的可能性。 我们的干预措施同样证实了分析,但属于“事后”性质:它们没有确定如何防止在培训期间造成记忆,它们对稳健性和其他预测的影响仍然不清楚。
最后,我们的调查结果涉及在Pythia家族中高达6.9 6.9 B参数的逐字记录。 它们对于较大的模型、其他建筑以及其他形式的记忆,例如在视觉领域或吵闹的标签设置中,其普遍性仍然开放。

blocks.en: Appendix B Additional experiment settings

blocks.en: B.1 Models
blocks.zh: B.1 模式

blocks.en: We use EleutherAI/pythia-<size>-deduped GPT NeoX checkpoints loaded from huggingface and the corresponding tokenizer. Our decomposition implementation is a fork of the original ExPLAIND repository, extended with the Pythia reconstruction, sample level decomposition, prediction, and ablation code used here. Models are loaded through FixedLossGPTNeoXForCausalLM with Flash Attention 2, and dropout is disabled. Computation uses float32 by default and bfloat16 for the 6.9B model to reduce memory use. We restricted each decomposition to one H200 GPU; we did not decompose the 12B model because of the computational cost. We reconstruct AdamW with Pythia’s learning rate schedule, betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) , epsilon 10 − 8 10^{-8} , weight decay 0.01 0.01 , gradient clipping with norm limit a 1 1 , and zero the first moments. Second moments are estimated from the 256 sequences above. The path integral in the test feature map of ExPLAIND uses 100 100 integration steps following Eichin et al. (2026) ’s recommendation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 EleutherAI/pythia- < small>- deduped 。 常规 NeoX检查站从拥抱面和相应的装饰器上装载. 我们的分解执行是原来的ExPLAIND寄存器的叉子,与Pythia重建,样品级分解,预测,以及这里使用的衰减代码相扩展. 模型通过 Flash 注意2 的 FixdLossGPTNeoXForCausalLM 装入,退出则被禁用. 计算默认使用浮32和bfloat16,用于6.9B模型以减少内存使用. 我们每次分解都限制在一个H200 GPU;我们没有分解12B模型,因为计算成本. 我们用 Pythia 的学习速度表重建 AdamW, β( 0. 9, 0. 95), epsilon 10 − 8 10^{-8 }, 重量衰减 0.01 0.01, 梯度剪切 规范限制 1 1, 初时为零 。 从上面的256个序列中估计出第二个时刻。 ExPLAIND测试特征图中包含的路径按照Eichin等人(2026年)的建议使用了100个集成步骤.

blocks.en: B.2 Data
blocks.zh: B.2 数据

blocks.en: For each selected deduplicated Pythia model, we sample the first 64 Pythia tokenizer tokens of 32 examples in each of four classes. The classes are defined by 32-extractability in as precomputed by Biderman et al. (2023a) (code at github repo EleutherAI/pythia-memorized-evals ) and by the occurrence count of the 32-token continuation in the deduplicated Pile, taken from huggingface dataset usvsnsp/deduped-num-duplicates : memorized_recited (extractable, count > 5 >5 ), memorized_recollected (extractable, count ≤ 5 \leq 5 ), control_duplicated (not extractable, count > 5 >5 ), and control (not extractable, count ≤ 5 \leq 5 ), following Prashanth et al. (2025) . Controls come from the tail of the preshuffled deduplicated Pile mmap and exclude memorized indices. The 128 prediction examples pass a text filter that rejects excessive capitalization, selected code characters, more than five digits, and repeated substrings. The reconstruction uses 1,024 sequences of 2,048 tokens for the original update and a disjoint set of 256 sequences to estimate the second moment; these sequences also come from the Pile tail but are not subject to the text filter.
blocks.zh: 对于每个被选中的复制的 Pythia 模型,我们抽取了前64个 Pythia 代号符号,在四个类中每个类中都有32个实例. 分类的定义是32可提取性,由Biderman等人(2023年a)(在github repo EleutherAI/pythia-memorized-evals中编码)进行预提取,以及从拥抱面数据集usvsnsp/dedupded-num-duplies中提取的32个托肯续作的发生计数: 记住_引用(可复制,数 > 5 > 5),记住_收回(可复制,数\ 5\leq 5),控制_重复(不可提取,数 > 5 > 5),控制(不可提取,数\ 5\leq 5),紧随普拉尚特等人(2025). 控制来源于预发性减缩的Pile mmap的尾部,排除了被记住的指数. 128个预测实例通过一个文本过滤器,拒绝过度资本化,选定代码字符,超过5位数,以及重复的子字符串. 重建使用1,024个序列2,048个令牌进行原始更新,并使用256个序列的脱节组合来估计第二瞬间;这些序列也来自皮尔尾巴,但不受文本过滤.

blocks.en: B.3 ExPLAIND decomposition and features
blocks.zh: B.3 ExPLAIND分解和特征

blocks.en: Our implementation is a fork of the original ExPLAIND repository, extended with the Pythia reconstruction, sample level decomposition, prediction, and ablation code used here. We evaluate checkpoints at steps 0 , 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 , 256 , 512 0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,512 , every 1,000 1,000 steps from 1,000 1,000 through 9,000 9,000 , and every 10,000 10,000 steps from 10,000 10,000 through 130,000 130,000 . We decompose all 128 sequences separately and retain training sequences as separate, accumulated group. Sequence loss follows Pythia’s update convention, namely the token loss sum divided by 2,048.
blocks.zh: 我们的实施是原ExPLAIND寄存器的叉子,与Pythia重建,样本级分解,预测,以及这里使用的衰减代码相扩展. 我们按0、1、2、4、8、16、32、64、128、256、512、0、1、2、4、8、16、32、64、128、256、512等步骤评估检查站,每1 000步从1 000步到9 000、每10 000步从1 000步到130 000步到130 000步。 我们把128个序列单独分解,保留训练序列作为单独的,累积的组别. 序列损失是Pythia更新协议之后发生的,即象征性损失除以2,048。

blocks.en: B.4 Memorization prediction
blocks.zh: B.4 记忆预测

blocks.en: For the prediction, at each checkpoint we compute five features for every prediction sequence: cosine alignment with the original training update, cosine alignment with the matching sequence update, the prediction feature norm, the matching update feature norm, and alignment with the weight decay contribution. Dot products and squared norms are summed across parameters. Prediction uses the features of one checkpoint at a time; accumulated scores are used only for the descriptive decomposition plots and ablations. The plots report class means and standard deviations for both the memorized versus control grouping and the four classes. We also evaluate BLiMP at every checkpoint by comparing the summed sentence log probabilities in each minimal pair.
blocks.zh: 对于预测,在每个检查点,我们计算每个预测序列的五个特征:与原始训练更新的余弦配合,与匹配序列更新的余弦配合,预测特征规范,匹配更新特征规范,以及与重量衰减贡献的对齐. 点产品和方块规范是跨参数的汇总. 预测一次使用一个检查点的特征;累积分数只用于描述性的分解图案和擦伤. 地块报告分类意味着记忆与控制分组和四个分类的标准偏差。 我们还在每个检查站通过比较每一对最低限度的句子总和的逻辑概率来评估BLIMP.

blocks.en: We fit ridge linear models with an unpenalized intercept and coefficient 10 − 8 10^{-8} using six stratified folds generated with seed 42. Feature standardization is fitted only on the training portion of each fold. Binary predictions threshold the scalar output at 0.5 0.5 . We evaluate decomposition features, CE, and decomposition+CE, using one checkpoint at a time. We report accuracy from predictions on the excluded folds and retain the scores, predictions, labels, fold assignments, and fitted weights.
blocks.zh: 我们用无惩罚的截流模型和系数10 - 8 10 - 8 使用用42号种子生成的6个分层折叠。 特色标准化只适用于每套培训部分。 二进制预测将分级输出阈值为0.50.5。 我们评估分解特征,CE和分解+CE,一次使用一个检查点. 我们从排除折叠的预测中报告准确性,并保留分数、预测、标签、折叠分配和配重。

blocks.en: B.5 Causal ablation
blocks.zh: B.5 因果关系

blocks.en: For each checkpoint, we sum parameter influences from the 64 memorized sequences over that checkpoint and all earlier checkpoints. We select the most negative fractions specified by the ablation script and replace those parameters with zero. Normalization parameters are always excluded. We report separate scopes that exclude embeddings or include them; each fraction is relative to the eligible parameters in its scope. Random masks with the same number of parameters provide a baseline. After intervention, we measure teacher forced greedy accuracy following a 32-token prefix, mean token loss, and the number of sequences for which all 32 continuation tokens are decoded greedily, both for the binary groups and for each of the four classes. We additionally measure control CE and the fraction of greedily generated control tokens changed by the intervention.
blocks.zh: 对于每个检查站,我们汇总了64个记录在检查站和以前所有检查站上的参数。 我们选择由衰减脚本指定的最负分数,并将这些参数替换为零. 正常化参数总是被排除在外。 我们报告排除嵌入或包含其内容的单独范围;每个部分与其范围内的合格参数相对。 具有同样数量参数的随机面具提供了一个基线. 经过干预,我们测量了老师在32个托肯前缀之后强迫贪婪的准确性,意味着象征性的丢失,以及所有32个续作符号都被贪婪地解码的序列数量,无论是对于二进制组还是对于四门课中的每门课都是如此. 我们额外衡量控制CE 和部分贪婪 产生了控制标志 由干预改变。

blocks.en: C.4 A Shared memorization mechanism in lower layer attention heads
blocks.zh: C.4 低层关注头的共同记忆机制

blocks.en: We also track the alignment of our decomposed sequences with each other and plot the result in Fig. 8 . Interestingly, recited instances tend to have a high level of alignment with each other throughout all of training. This trend is also followed by the other instances in early training until around step 64 64 . This alignment suggests that memorization learning in these instances tends towards a shared mechanism. To understand where in the model such a mechanism might be located, we turn to our layer-wise alignment decomposition and find that until around step 20 20 k, the alignment largely stems from attention heads in the lower layers.
blocks.zh: 我们还追踪我们分解的序列彼此的对齐情况,并将结果写成Fig。 8 (英语). 有趣的是,在所有培训中,所宣读的事例往往彼此高度一致。 在早期培训中,这一趋势也随之出现,直到大约第64步。 这种配合表明,在这些情况下,记忆学习倾向于一种共同机制。 为了了解这种机制在模型中可能在哪里,我们转向了我们分层的对齐分解,发现直到20k步左右,对齐主要来自下层的注意力头.

blocks.en: Memorization in smaller models is ablated by a single attention head. To further investigate the mechanism that could be implemented there, we turn to our parameter interventions. Due to our implementation, we do not have access to the decomposition on the level of single attention heads, but only entire attention layers. Therefore, one by one, we zero-intervene on the parameters of all the attention heads in the TOP-3 attention layers as ordered by their layer alignment. We observe 32-extractability of the memorized instances and cross-entropy of the control instances and plot the result in App. Fig. 23 . While most attention heads tend to have little influence on the memorization behavior of the memorized sequences we study, we find that ablating attention head 0 0 in layer 0 0 to have a big effect on memorization reducing the amount of 32-extractable sequences to 5 5 and 1 1 for the 64 64 recited and recollected sequences respectively. At the same time, control cross-entropy increases by around 0.25 0.25 , leaving large parts of the model intact.
blocks.zh: 在较小的模型中,记忆被单个的注意力头所淡化. 为了进一步调查可以在那里实施的机制,我们转而谈谈我们的参数干预。 由于我们的实施,我们无法进入单一关注头级的分解层,而只能进入整个关注层. 因此,一个接一个,我们在TOP-3关注层中所有关注头的参数上,按照它们的层对齐顺序进行零干扰. 我们观测到32可提取的记忆实例和对照实例的交叉切入,并在App.图23中绘制结果。 虽然大多数注意力头往往对我们研究的记忆序列的记忆行为影响不大,但我们发现,将注意力头在0层0对记忆产生巨大影响,将64个诵读和重拾序列的32个可提取序列分别减少到5个5个和1个. 同时,控制跨交替增加约0.250.25,使模型的大部分完好无损.

blocks.en: This finding echos results presented by Stoehr et al. (2024) , who find that memorization in a small GPT-Neo model can also be ablated by fine-tuning a single attention head. Our result indicates, that this sub-mechanism for memorization develops early in training.Further, we show that this finding generalizes to much larger models around 1 1 B, indicating that it is not just a phenomenon in smaller, more constricted settings. On the other hand, our naive search and intervention did not yield the same result in the larger models starting from 1.4 1.4 B as can be seen in App. Fig. 24 . There, the maximum attention alignment with other sequences moves upwards in the model (see App. Fig. 18 ), in sum suggesting a more refined and replicated mechanism there.
blocks.zh: 这个发现与Stoehr等人(2024年)提出的结果相呼应,他们发现在小型的GPT-Neo模型中的记忆也可以通过微调单个的注意力头来减弱. 我们的结果显示,这种用于纪念的子机制在训练的早期发展. 此外,我们表明,这一发现概括到11B左右更大的模型中,表明它不仅仅是在较小的、较为狭窄的环境中的现象。 另一方面,我们的天真搜索和干预并没有产生同样的结果,从1.4 1.4 B开始的更大的模型从App. Fig. 24. 在那里,与模型中其他序列的最大注意力对调(见App.Fig. 18)向上移动,总之,建议在那里有一个更精细和复制的机制.
